context.note: Back up the ledger database before you close a period, so that you can go back if a posting is wrong.
context.p: Record the change in the audit log and tell the controller which accounts it touched before the period closes.
Select OK to close the dialog box and go back to the page where you started.
context.note: Only a ledger administrator can reopen a closed period, and every reopening is written to the audit log.
